name: Quality Living
overview: Quality living, according to Scripture, is rooted in trusting the Lord and embracing His commandments, which leads to a life marked by righteousness, mercy, and honor. True blessing comes from seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, ensuring that our daily labors are enjoyed as a gift from God. This life of quality is not measured by material wealth but by a humble and faithful heart that delights in the goodness of the Lord.
